why: `rise` left out of the arm. The player picks a spawn STYLE, but arrival-versus-destruction is a property of the EVENT, so a language that holds for warp and beacon and not rise leaves a third of players seeing the exact confusion the issue reports -- and seeing it intermittently, which is the hardest kind to report. Chosen as the mutation because `rise` is the one style whose shipped ring is a symmetric bump rather than an obvious expansion, so it is the one an author is most likely to think already reads differently.
killedBy: converge: an arrival gathers instead of expanding (issue #230) opposed: every style converges instead
